workflow: .agents/skills/skill-model: PokeAPI official artwork → openrouter/google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1 2×2 sheet → split-sheet.py → multiview-to-model
budgetNote: Part of the 2670-credit P4–P6 grant (docs/ZONE-CONTENT.md §2, models 75–81). Account balance is shared with concurrent batches P4 and P5, so per-batch balance before/after is not recorded; credits come from each task record. All seven submissions were accepted on the first try (no HTTP 429).
shippingPipeline: assets/prepare-game-models.py (Blender 5.2.3); swarm 900 (hitmonchan) / 1300 (dugtrio, ninetales, flareon) triangles, 512px base colour; guardians magmar, arcanine and dragonite undecimated, 1024px; no rigging or paid conversion
facingVerification: Raw and shipping GLBs rendered from the run camera and four sides with render-compare.py, plus a lineup at proposed sim heights next to rattata, golem and scyther; all seven face glTF +X like rattata, so they take the default yaw (-π/2) and need no facingYaw entry.
viewFollowUps: Emissive treatment is view work, not shipped here: magmar body flames, flareon mane (and its burning-ring aura).
rights: Unofficial, free non-commercial Pokémon fan project. Pokémon characters and names belong to their respective rights holders. AI generation does not transfer those character rights.

assets.note: Decimated to 1300, not 900: at 900 the tail fan tore UV seams into white flecks. Nine tails form one closed fan behind the body, so the footprint is deep; proposed height 1.3, radius 0.6.

assets.name: 快拳郎
assets.note: Clean at 900. Gloves held at hip height, clear of the body; proposed height 1.3, radius 0.5 (like hitmonlee).

assets.name: 火伊布
